text:
kyle: Hi team — customer reports they suddenly can't edit project 'acme-prod' in the console; Settings and billing actions are grayed out and they get a 403 when clicking Edit.

maria: Do we have the console request id and user email? Any IdP group changes?

kyle: Request id: r-0a1b2c3d; user alice@acme.com. SCIM log shows groups: [acme-admins]. They were in that group before.

ops-jess: I pulled the auth logs — the session exchange returned a delegated token missing `project:edit`. Looks like a scope was trimmed during a delegated-token exchange.

eng-oncall-chris: Repro steps: open DevTools > Network, click Edit on project -> XHR to /api/projects/123/actions returns 403 with code AUTHZ_MISSING_SCOPE. Check `Authorization` header.

kyle: Paste of response:
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
x-request-id: r-0a1b2c3d
content-type: application/json
{
  "error": "forbidden",
  "code": "AUTHZ_MISSING_SCOPE",
  "details": "token missing scope 'project:edit'"
}
```

maria: Is this only the console session or an API key? If IdP returned extra claims recently, our delegated-scope sanitizer might have clipped scopes.

kyle: Only seen in the console session; they can still list projects (project:read works). Edit actions require project:edit.

support-bot: deploy-bot: Released `delegated-scope-trim-fix` to staging at 2025-08-05T15:28Z :rocket:

ops-jess: Root cause: Okta started returning a bunch of extra group claims which pushed the token/claims length over our threshold (2048 chars). Our exchange service falls back to a "safe" trimmed scope set which omitted `project:edit`. Fix: adjust threshold and stop stripping core edit scopes. Will backfill affected sessions.

eng-oncall-chris: Workaround for customers: force a full session rotation (logout -> login) or we can rotate their delegated session token via internal support tooling: `POST /internal/support/rotate-session?user=alice@acme.com`.

kyle: Customer tried logout/login — no luck (they used incognito). Jess can you run the rotate for alice?

ops-jess: Running now: `internal-tool rotate-session --user alice@acme.com` -> OK. New request id r-9f8e7d6c.

kyle: Confirmed with customer: Edit buttons now enabled, they can update billing and settings. :tada:

maria: I'll open a short postmortem, track the IdP claim size risk, and add a regression test. @eng-oncall-chris can you add the fix + test to infra board?

eng-oncall-chris: On it. Adding ticket and regression for long-group-claim edge-case.

kyle: Thanks everyone — closing support case after customer confirmation.
